items.title: Anthropic clamps down on Claude’s AI video game clones
items.summary: Anthropic has updated Claude Code's system prompt to prevent the AI tool from being used to re-create existing video games, as reported by Tom's Hardware. items.title: OpenAI pitches data center power plants as a way to protect nearby areas
items.summary: In an announcement on Monday, OpenAI says it will pilot its "Grid Protectors Program" at an upcoming data center in Effingham County, Georgia, where the company promises to free up to 1,000 megawatts of power during extreme weather or emergencies, enough to power air conditioners in around 700,000 homes. items.title: The New York Times sues Brave web browser for AI scraping and bypassing paywalls
items.summary: The New York Times and a group of other publications have filed lawsuits against the company that makes the Brave web browser over alleged unlawful scraping to train AI and also letting users bypass their paywalls, as reported by Reuters.
